### Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery. We should prepare now to make that progress serve everyone.

2. We believe superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will double the pace of scientific discovery. That means breakthroughs can come faster—and we need to be ready to put them to work for the public good.

3. Superintelligent AI, built within the next 20 years, will double the pace of scientific discovery. We can help shape what comes next by investing in responsible research and broad access to its benefits.

### Newsletter opening

If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery. We hold this position plainly because the stakes are too high for timid thinking. Faster discovery could transform how we understand disease, develop clean energy, and solve challenges that have resisted generations of researchers. But progress does not automatically reach everyone or serve the public good. We must make choices now about the research we support, the safeguards we establish, and who has access to what comes next. We are bringing advocates, researchers, and communities into that work—so the coming acceleration in science delivers breakthroughs that improve lives, expand opportunity, and benefit all of us.
